radmin.helpText: Streamly connects friends through a free virtual network: Radmin VPN first, ZeroTier as a fallback. Everyone has to be in the same network.
radmin.step1: Install Radmin VPN and start it
radmin.step2: Host: Network → Create Network, pick a name and a password
radmin.step3: Friends: Network → Join Network with the same name and password
radmin.waiting: Waiting for the Radmin or ZeroTier network…

onboarding.subtitle: A couple of settings and you can invite friends
onboarding.nicknameHint: Friends will see it when you connect

home.hostText: Share your screen with friends and hand out controls
home.connectText: Find a friend on the network and join their screen
home.how1: Everyone joins the same Radmin VPN (or ZeroTier) network

host.title: Host
host.installHint: Windows will ask for permission: click Yes. It takes about a minute.
host.needsInstallText: Streamly will install Apollo (based on Sunshine): it sends video, audio and input. Administrator rights are needed once.
host.credentialsText: Apollo was already installed with your own password. Enter its web panel login once and Streamly will handle the rest.
host.addressHint: Friends will find you automatically. If not, tell them this address.
host.noPlayersHint: Ask your friends to press Connect in Streamly
host.noGamepadDriver: Virtual gamepad driver (ViGEmBus) not found: friends' gamepads will not work.
host.stoppedText: Press to start sharing your screen with friends again.
host.inviteCopied: Invite with a link copied. Send it to your friends: they just copy the message and open Streamly.
host.uploadHint: Each player gets their own stream. Make sure your internet upload speed is higher than this.
host.padLimit: Windows sees at most 4 Xbox gamepads on one PC (including the host's own). Turn off gamepad access for players who do not need it, or someone's pad will not show up in games.
host.driverFailed: Could not install the gamepad driver. Download ViGEmBus manually and restart the PC.
host.kickAllConfirm: All players will be disconnected. Trusted friends can only come back after you accept them.
host.newDeviceHint: This device connects for the first time — make sure it is your friend
host.pendingRestart: Screen settings changed: they apply when all players leave.
host.selfOffHint: The player turned off their own {{what}}
host.poorNetworkHint: The player's Moonlight is losing packets. Lowering the quality (in their Alt+F2 menu) or the bitrate cap helps.
host.muteChatHint: The player asks to keep Discord out of the stream
host.chatExcluded: Discord is kept out of the stream at the players’ request.
host.chatExcludedMonitor: Discord is kept out of the stream at the players’ request. You hear the game through the virtual speakers.

chatUnavailable.noVirtualSink: Players ask to remove Discord, but Steam Streaming Speakers are missing. Install Steam and restart "I'm the host".
chatUnavailable.disabled: Players ask to remove Discord, but it is turned off in the host settings ("Keep Discord out of the stream").
chatUnavailable.noHelper: Players ask to remove Discord, but Streamly's sound module is missing. Reinstall Streamly.

host.pausedBanner: Everyone's controls are paused (Alt+F12). They see the game but can't press anything.
host.encoderHint: What Apollo encodes video with. A graphics card handles several players; the CPU does not.
host.softwareEncoder: Video is encoded on the CPU: several players will stutter. Update the graphics driver and restart "I'm the host".
host.wrongGpu: {{encoder}} encodes the video, but this PC has {{gpu}}. The monitor is probably plugged into the motherboard: plug it into the graphics card and restart "I'm the host".
host.apolloDown: Apollo stopped responding — restarting it. Players will reconnect on their own in a few seconds.
host.spectateHint: Let in as a spectator: watches without keyboard, mouse or gamepad
host.passControlHint: All control to this player only, everyone else loses it (handy for taking turns)
host.padSlotHint: Gamepad number on the host (the player's order in the game)
host.makePadFirstHint: Players' gamepads reconnect one by one starting with this one (a couple of seconds)

connect.title: Connect
connect.searching: Looking for hosts on Radmin and ZeroTier…
connect.nothingHint: Make sure your friend pressed “I'm the host” and you are in the same Radmin or ZeroTier network. Or enter their address manually.

steps.waitingApproval: Waiting for the host to accept

connect.approvalHint: The host will see your request and press Allow
connect.streamingText: The stream is open in a separate window. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X toggles fullscreen, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q ends the stream.
connect.hostAudio: Audio also plays on the host
connect.firewallHint: If Windows asks to allow Moonlight, press Allow.
connect.measuring: Measuring the connection to the host…

errors.no_radmin: Not connected to Radmin VPN or ZeroTier
errors.apollo_install_failed: Could not install the streaming server
errors.apollo_unreachable: The streaming server is not responding
errors.apollo_auth: Could not sign in to Apollo
errors.install_cancelled: Installation cancelled: administrator rights are required
errors.port_busy: Port is busy: Streamly may already be hosting
errors.host_full: The host has no free slots
errors.moonlight_missing: Moonlight client not found. Please reinstall Streamly.
errors.version_mismatch: You and the host run different Streamly versions
errors.host_not_hosting: The host has not started hosting
errors.pair_no_request: Moonlight could not reach the host server

settings.title: Settings
settings.vsyncHint: Removes tearing at the cost of a little latency
settings.absoluteMouseHint: Turn off for games with a mouse-look camera
settings.packetSizeHint: Lower it if the picture breaks up over the VPN
settings.defaultPermsHint: What a friend gets right after joining. You can change it live.
settings.trustedEmpty: Nobody yet. Press “Always allow” when a friend joins.
settings.aboutText: Streamly combines Apollo (a Sunshine fork) for hosting and Moonlight for connecting. Both projects are licensed under GPL-3.0.
settings.closeToTrayHint: While hosting or streaming, the close button hides the window to the tray instead of quitting
settings.autoStartHostingHint: Together with Windows autostart, friends can join as soon as the PC is on

presetsHint.economy: 720p · 60 FPS · 6 Mbps — for slow internet or a Radmin relay
presetsHint.balanced: Monitor resolution · 60 FPS · auto bitrate (up to the host cap) — fits most setups
presetsHint.high: Monitor resolution · 120 FPS · 50 Mbps — for a fast network and an RTX host; never above the host and player screens

settings.maxBitrateHint: Limits the host upload. Auto gives 1–2 players more and splits the channel with 3–4. A new value applies to players who join after the change
settings.keepHostAudio: Game audio stays on the host
settings.keepHostAudioHint: Needed for playing together: the host hears the game too. Turn off if only your friends play.
settings.selfCheckHint: Apollo, ports, firewall, drivers — everything friends need to connect
settings.volumeHint: Only for you; the host and other players are not affected
settings.muteChatHint: The host removes their Discord from the stream audio, so you don't hear yourself and your friends twice. Applies to all of the host's players.
settings.overlayKeyHint: Volume, Discord, your own controls, quality and switching to your second monitor
settings.displayHintEmpty: The monitor list appears after the first "I'm the host"
settings.virtualExplain: Apollo creates a separate screen at the player's resolution. While playing it becomes the primary one: the desktop and taskbar move there, and your monitor becomes the second one. Move the game window to the virtual screen (Win+Shift+arrow). When everyone leaves, your screens go back to how they were.
settings.virtualOnly: Turn off my monitors while playing
settings.virtualOnlyHint: Friends see the whole desktop, and your monitors stay blank until the game ends
settings.lossProtectionHint: High adds redundant packets so network losses don't turn into stutters. Traffic grows by about 10%.
settings.pendingRestart: Screen changes apply when all players leave (Apollo restarts for a couple of seconds).
settings.chatRouting: Keep Discord out of the stream
settings.chatRoutingHint: When players ask, Discord is left out of the stream audio. Requires Steam Streaming Speakers (present when Steam is installed). You hear the game with about 30 ms delay.
settings.autoQualityHint: Before streaming, Streamly measures the channel to the host the way video travels (over UDP), watches it for congestion during the game and remembers what the connection to each host can handle
settings.hdrHint: Turn on HDR in Windows display settings on both PCs. Without support Moonlight streams as usual
settings.yuv444Hint: Small text and UI without color fringing. Needs more bandwidth and support on both sides, otherwise the normal mode is used
settings.inviteAutoAdmit: Let invited friends in without approval
settings.inviteAutoAdmitHint: The Invite link works for 12 hours and until hosting stops

encoderPresetHint.latency: Fastest encoding (NVENC P1): lowest latency, slightly rougher picture
encoderPresetHint.balanced: Recommended for RTX: NVENC P3 — noticeably cleaner at almost the same latency
encoderPresetHint.quality: NVENC P5 with adaptive quantization: best picture, +1–3 ms per frame. For 1–2 players on a strong GPU
encoderPresetHint.custom: Settings for each GPU below: Apollo uses the ones that match the encoder it found

settings.bitrateCapAuto: Auto: 20 Mbps for one player, 15 for two, 10–12 for three or four
settings.encoderCustomHint: Defaults are tuned for NVIDIA RTX 40/50 and a Ryzen CPU. With an AMD graphics card or an Intel CPU with integrated graphics, tune your group: Apollo uses the settings of the encoder it found (marked). Applied by restarting Apollo when nobody is playing.

enc.nvPresetHint: P1 is the fastest, P7 the best. On RTX 40/50 P3–P5 is sensible; P6–P7 for a single player
enc.nvTwoPassHint: More even frame sizes (fewer network bursts). Quarter resolution costs almost nothing
enc.aqHint: Cleaner dark and smooth areas, slightly more encoder load
enc.amdRcHint: Low-latency VBR is best for streaming; CBR is steadier but looks worse in static scenes
enc.amdPreanalysisHint: Slightly better picture but adds latency. Usually off for streaming
enc.qsvPresetHint: For Intel integrated graphics with several players use Fast or faster
enc.swPresetHint: Only if the graphics card can't encode. Even a strong CPU handles one or two players
enc.swThreadsHint: Minimum threads for encoding. For an 8-core Ryzen — 4–8

settings.showAdvancedHint: Show rarely needed settings: encoding, bitrate, resolution, mouse modes and more
settings.diagnosticsCopied: Report copied — paste it into your problem report
settings.fullscreenWarn: Exclusive fullscreen may flicker when the Alt+F2 menu opens and gets in the way of a second monitor. Borderless is better.
settings.framePacingHint: Smoother frames at the cost of a little latency
settings.singleGamepadHint: Turn on if the game sees two gamepads instead of one (Steam Input, DS4Windows)
settings.requestSoundHint: A short chime when someone wants to join or asks for control; the tray icon blinks
settings.gameNotifyHint: A card in the screen corner while you play: answer with the mouse or hotkeys, the game is not minimised

priorityHint.latency: Video gets 70% of the measured channel: headroom against network queues — lower latency, slightly softer picture
priorityHint.balanced: 80% of the channel, frames shown right away — suits most people
priorityHint.quality: 90% of the channel, frame pacing and AV1 if both graphics cards support it; slightly higher latency

errorHints.no_radmin: Start Radmin VPN (or ZeroTier) and join the shared network with your friends. The indicator at the top should turn green.
errorHints.apollo_install_failed: The Apollo installer failed. Check that your antivirus is not blocking it and press Retry.
errorHints.apollo_unreachable: The Apollo service is not responding. Open Windows Services and check that "Apollo Service" is running, or restart the PC.
errorHints.apollo_auth: Enter the login and password of the Apollo web panel (https://localhost:47990).
errorHints.install_cancelled: Press Retry and choose Yes in the Windows prompt.
errorHints.port_busy: Port 47900 is busy: another copy of Streamly is open, or Windows reserved this port (Hyper-V/WSL). Close the extra copy; if that does not help, restart the PC.
errorHints.sunshine_conflict: Sunshine is running and uses the same ports as Apollo. Stop "Sunshine Service" in Windows Services (or uninstall Sunshine) and press Retry.
errorHints.host_unreachable: Make sure you and the host are in the same Radmin network and the host has a green dot in Radmin. If the connection goes through a relay, restart Radmin on both PCs — or try ZeroTier.
errorHints.host_not_hosting: The host PC is reachable, but Streamly is not in host mode there. Ask your friend to open Streamly and press "I'm the host".
errorHints.host_full: All slots are taken. Wait for someone to leave or ask the host to raise the limit in settings.
errorHints.denied: The host pressed Decline. You can ask again in 30 seconds.
errorHints.kicked: To come back, connect again: the host will have to accept the request.
errorHints.host_stopped: The host stopped hosting. Connect again once they start it.
errorHints.pair_failed: Try connecting again. If it keeps failing, ask the host to stop and restart hosting.
errorHints.pair_no_request: A firewall or antivirus on the host PC blocks Apollo (TCP 47984, 47989, 48010 and UDP 47998–48000). The host needs to allow Apollo in the firewall.
errorHints.stream_failed: Moonlight could not start the stream. Try the H.264 codec and 1080p in streaming settings.
errorHints.stream_timeout: The Moonlight window opened but no video arrived. Usually UDP ports 47998–48000 are closed on the host, or the packet is too large for the VPN. Try packet size 1024 in settings.
errorHints.moonlight_missing: Reinstall Streamly: Moonlight files are damaged or were removed by an antivirus.
errorHints.version_mismatch: Install the same Streamly version as the host.
errorHints.connection_lost: The connection to the host dropped. Check Radmin VPN (or ZeroTier) and connect again.
errorHints.unknown: Copy the report and send it to whoever set up Streamly.
errorHints.host_busy: The streaming server on the host PC is restarting or busy. Wait a minute and connect again.

hints.radmin: Start Radmin VPN and join the shared network.
hints.notRadminAddress: This is neither a Radmin address (26.x.x.x) nor one from your ZeroTier network. It only works inside one local network.
hints.pingBlocked: Ping does not get through. That is normal: Windows often blocks it in the firewall. See the next items.
hints.highLatency: High latency: Radmin probably routes you through a relay. Restart Radmin on both PCs or pick Economy in settings.
hints.notHosting: The host PC responds, but Streamly is not in host mode. Ask your friend to press "I'm the host".
hints.streamlyFirewall: The host PC responds, but the Streamly port is closed. The host needs to allow Streamly in the firewall or antivirus (or press "I'm the host" again — Streamly adds the rule).
hints.noRoute: The host PC does not respond at all. Check that it is on and you share a network (Radmin: green dot next to it; ZeroTier: both ticked Auth).
hints.apolloNotRunning: The streaming server is not running on the host. Host: Services → "Apollo Service" → start, or restart the PC.
hints.apolloFirewall: The streaming server ports are closed. The host needs to allow Apollo in the firewall or antivirus.
hints.apolloInstall: Press "I'm the host" — Streamly will install Apollo.
hints.apolloService: Open Windows Services and start "Apollo Service", or press "I'm the host" — Streamly will try to start it.
hints.sunshine: Stop "Sunshine Service" or uninstall Sunshine: it uses the same ports.
hints.firewall: Press "I'm the host" — Streamly will add the firewall rule (asks for administrator rights).
hints.vigem: Without the ViGEmBus driver friends' gamepads will not work. Press "Install driver" on the host panel.
hints.apolloApi: Apollo does not respond on this PC. Restart "Apollo Service" or restart the PC.
hints.apolloPorts: Apollo does not listen on the required ports. Another program may use them (Sunshine, Parsec, etc.).
hints.hosting: Hosting is off — friends cannot connect.
hints.hostAudio: The host will not hear the game. Turn on "Game audio stays on the host" in settings.
hints.chatRoutingError: Windows didn't allow redirecting Discord's sound. See the Streamly log for details.
hints.noVirtualSink: Steam Streaming Speakers are needed: install Steam and restart "I'm the host".
hints.chatDisabled: Turned off in the host settings.
hints.noHelper: Streamly's sound module is missing: reinstall Streamly.
hints.chatStarting: The sound module did not respond. Restart "I'm the host"; if that doesn't help, save the log archive and send it.
hints.softwareEncoder: Video is encoded on the CPU: update the graphics driver and restart "I'm the host".
hints.wrongGpu: The wrong GPU encodes: plug the monitor into the graphics card, not the motherboard.
hints.apolloOutdated: An older Apollo is installed: Streamly ships a newer one. Stop hosting, uninstall Apollo in "Apps & features" and press "I'm the host" again — Streamly will install the new version (Streamly settings are kept).
hints.zerotier: Start ZeroTier and join the host network.
hints.radminOrZt: This is the host's Radmin address, but only ZeroTier is connected here. Ask the host for the ZeroTier address (shown in the host window) or start Radmin VPN.
hints.notInZtNetwork: The address is neither from Radmin nor from your ZeroTier network. Check that you share the ZeroTier network with the host and the host ticked Auth for you.

summary.allGood: Connection is fine — you can connect
summary.noRadmin: Connect to Radmin VPN or ZeroTier first
summary.noRoute: No connection to the host PC over Radmin or ZeroTier
summary.notHosting: The host has not pressed "I'm the host" yet
summary.apolloBlocked: The host firewall blocks the streaming server
summary.hostOk: The host is ready for friends
summary.hostWarnings: The host works, but there are warnings
summary.hostProblems: There are problems, friends cannot connect
summary.checkFailed: The check did not run — please try again

stream.chatUnknown: The host hasn't said yet whether Discord can be removed
stream.chatUnavailable: Not available on the host: Steam's virtual speakers are needed (install Steam on the host PC)
stream.chatIncluded: The host's Discord is heard in the stream
stream.chatExcluded: Discord is removed from the stream: you won't hear yourself
stream.chatPending: Discord will be removed from the stream as soon as it starts
stream.myInputHint: Turn off so you don't get in the host's way by accident. Lock — turned off by the host.
stream.applyHint: The stream restarts for a few seconds
stream.poorNetwork: The connection to the host is losing packets, so the picture may stutter. Lowering the quality helps.
stream.unstable: Unstable connection: {{rtt}} ms latency, {{jitter}} ms jitter. Radmin may be using a relay, or the network is busy.
stream.requestHint: The host turned off some of your controls — you can ask for them
stream.requestDenied: The host said no. You can ask again in half a minute.
stream.autoActive: Chosen: {{summary}}. If the connection starts losing packets, quality drops automatically.
stream.autoNext: On: the connection is measured when the stream starts next time.
stream.poorNetworkAuto: The connection is losing packets. If it continues, quality will drop automatically.
stream.autoLowered: Auto quality lowered the quality because of a poor connection.
stream.gamepadHint: Reconnecting restarts the stream for a couple of seconds
stream.gamepadOff: The host turned your gamepad off
stream.signalLost: Lost connection to the host — reconnecting, the game keeps going…
stream.capLowered: The host rebalanced bandwidth between players: bitrate up to {{mbps}} Mbit/s
stream.padsHint: Who controls which gamepad in the host's game (number 1 is usually the host's own).
stream.padsUnknown: Numbers are not known yet — the host learns them when gamepads connect.
stream.identifyHint: Not sure about your number — press "Which is mine?" and then any button on your gamepad.
stream.identifyWaiting: Press any button on your gamepad…
stream.identifyNotFound: No button press (or the host runs an older Streamly).
stream.congestedAuto: The channel to the host is congested and latency is growing. Streamly is lowering the quality before the game starts stuttering.
stream.congested: The channel to the host is congested and latency is growing. Lower the quality or turn on auto quality.

overlay.title: Stream menu
overlay.otherScreenHint: The cursor moves to your other monitor. Click the stream window to come back.
overlay.tip: Esc or {{keys}} — back to the game. Mouse stuck in the stream window — Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z

invite.title: Invite from {{name}}
invite.noApproval: With this link the host lets you in right away, without approval.
invite.withApproval: The host will need to approve the connection.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.moonlightHint: Moonlight's statistics over the game (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S). Press again to hide.
stats.relayTip: Radmin seems to route you through its relay: higher latency, lower speed. Open Radmin VPN and check the connection type to the host; restarting Radmin on both PCs often helps.
stats.wifiTip: You're on Wi-Fi: a cable usually removes stutters and latency spikes.
stats.softwareTip: The host encodes on the CPU — several players will stutter.

update.title: Updates
update.autoHint: At startup and every few hours. Downloading and installing only happen when you click
update.unsupported: Updates work only in the installed version
update.optional: The update is optional — install it whenever it suits you
update.onQuit: Or it installs itself when you quit Streamly
update.busyWarn: Your game or hosting will stop while it installs (about a minute)

errors.network: Cannot reach GitHub — check your internet
errors.noRelease: This release has no update files — download the installer from GitHub
errors.checksum: The download was corrupted — try again

hostMenu.title: Host menu
hostMenu.tip: Esc or {{key}} — back to the game

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.hint: Click a field, then press a combination. Esc cancels, Backspace turns it off. Keys are only taken when needed: the player menu while playing, host keys while hosting.
hotkeys.invalid: {{key}} cannot be used: add Ctrl, Alt or Shift with an F key

hints.clientMenuAlt: If Moonlight captures Alt in fullscreen
hints.hostMenu: Requests and players without minimising the game
hints.hostAllow: The first join request or control request
hints.hostDeny: The first join request or control request

logs.title: Activity log
logs.hint: Streamly keeps a log for 14 days (the logs folder in Streamly data). If something goes wrong, save the archive and send it: it has the log, a system report, the last Moonlight log and, on the host, the Apollo log. No passwords or tokens.
logs.saved: Log archive saved — its folder is open
logs.failed: Could not save the log archive

hostNotify.more: and {{count}} more — open the host menu

pads.title: Gamepads
pads.hint: This is how Moonlight sees them. Moonlight doesn't send a gamepad without a mapping to the host — this happens with old gamepads that work in Parsec. For such a gamepad, click "Set up buttons" and go through a short wizard.
pads.unavailable: Streamly's helper module is unavailable, so the gamepad list can't be read. Reinstall Streamly.
pads.none: No gamepads found. Connect a gamepad and click "Refresh".
pads.warning: Moonlight doesn't see the gamepad "{{name}}", so the host won't get it. Set up its buttons — it takes a minute.
pads.saved: Mapping for "{{name}}" saved. It takes effect the next time the stream starts.
pads.overwrite: the previous mapping will be replaced
pads.rest: Put the gamepad down and don't press anything…
pads.lost: The gamepad is disconnected. Connect it again.
pads.tooFew: Assign at least the bottom button (A) and three more.

zerotier.title: Or ZeroTier — when Radmin cannot connect
zerotier.text: The host creates a network at my.zerotier.com (free for up to 10 devices) and gives friends its ID. Friends: ZeroTier tray icon → “Join New Network…” → ID. The host ticks Auth for them in the member list. Streamly finds the network by itself.
